comment: Curated list of third-party libraries shipped in the Synapse Android app (:app plus the :shared runtime dependencies it packages). Grouped per library project, not per Maven artifact. licenseId is a stable token resolved to a localised label in res/values/about_app.xml; an unknown token is displayed verbatim rather than guessed. Keep this file in sync with app/build.gradle and shared/build.gradle.kts.
